$comment: Prompts for this game's art: npm run gen:asset -- xiangqi/<name> (the style in assets/prompts.json is added).

island.prompt: A floating sky island: rocky brown underside tapering to a point with a few hanging vines, lush green grass on top, and on top an oriental Chinese chess (xiangqi) board with round wooden disc pieces in red and black, a small bonsai pine tree and a stone lantern. Isometric 3/4 view, whole island visible.

board.prompt: A classic Chinese chess board viewed exactly from above, top-down orthographic, 9:10 portrait rectangle, slightly rounded corners. A thin raised dark walnut wooden rim occupying only 2.5 percent of the width on every edge, fine bevel highlight, narrow visible inner wall, subtle handcrafted patina. The flat empty playing surface fills 94 percent of the width and height: muted warm honey amber wood with calm fine grain. No grid lines, markings, pieces, text, symbols, gold ornament or red lacquer. Whole board visible with minimal transparent padding and a tight subtle shadow. Polished mobile board game art.

pavilion.prompt: A landscape 16:9 background for a Vietnamese xiangqi board game, viewed straight down at a 90-degree top-down orthographic angle: a tranquil moonlit Chinese lotus pond in a refined 3D animated interpretation of traditional ink-wash landscape painting (shui-mo). Show only the pond surface, never the sky or horizon. The whole central area, about 60 percent of the image width and the full height, is open calm deep jade-teal water with only faint broad ripples and a soft moonlit sheen: it stays empty, darker and low contrast because a separate chessboard is placed on top of it later. Nothing floats in the center: no raft, platform, table, mat, board, frame or rectangle of any kind. Keep all detail in the outer margins: soft charcoal-blue ink-wash willow canopies, a few subdued pink lotus flowers and lily pads, shoreline stones, and tiny traditional pavilion roof plans near the upper corners, all seen from directly above. Use broad painterly water washes, visible soft ink diffusion and brush strokes, delicate paper-like texture, graceful simplified 3D forms and tiny restrained amber lantern glows. Keep the side margins and lower corners dark, uncluttered and low contrast for HUD. No perspective tilt, no skyline, no chessboard, wooden surface, grid, pieces, people, calligraphy, UI, text, symbols, frame or watermark.
